editorial_note: Exhaustive formal masterpage codifying the species taxonomy, living concept dynamics, transavatar projections, primordial boundary realms (Holeisa), mechanical-metaphysical disciplines (Technogenesis), the Three Arthitean Ontostates with the 1/2/3 pair black-phoenix wing rule, and the strict canonical identity of Orotus as the Holy Black Phoenix Divine Beast (enforcing Orotus_Divine_Beast_Holy_Black_Phoenix_CANON_MODEL.png and rejecting the sheet-invalid reference).

hierarchy_ladder.name: Divine Beast & Sacred Totems
hierarchy_ladder.scope: Orotus Holy Black Phoenix & Kafai Ranks

concepts.name: Holeisa
concepts.canon_definition: The primordial metaphysical boundary and horizon entity that encapsulates and partitions distinct cosmic strata, timelines, and rewrite envelopes within the Arthratan cosmos.
concepts.clarification: Holeisa is both a geographical boundary-space and an active ontological constraint preventing total timeline collapse during multi-order Negative Rewrites.
concepts.commonly_confused_with: Standard outer space or dimensional walls.

concepts.name: Living Concepts
concepts.canon_definition: Autonomous, self-maintaining metaphysical concepts that possess intrinsic consciousness, intentionality, and biological/spiritual embodiment.
concepts.clarification: They are not ideas thought by beings, but beings that are themselves thoughts/laws of the cosmos capable of agency and combat.

concepts.name: Transavatars
concepts.canon_definition: Higher-order projections of divine or living-concept entities capable of traversing across paratemporal and rewrite boundaries without loss of identity.
concepts.clarification: Transavatars allow entities anchored in beginningless or acausal states to act within localized lower-dimensional realities.
concepts.commonly_confused_with: Clones or illusions (Transavatars carry true causal weight).

concepts.name: Nüreen
concepts.canon_definition: An ancient, highly organized humanoid species characterized by luminous soul-substrates, advanced metaphysical governance, and delicate yet impenetrable conceptual armor.
concepts.clarification: Historically coexisted with early Arthiteans; possess distinct non-phoenix wing structures and radiant energetic biology.

concepts.name: Archnüreen
concepts.canon_definition: The ascended ontostate of the Nüreen species, achieving near-perfect conceptual harmonization and immunity to lesser temporal rewrites.
concepts.clarification: Parallels the Archarthitean step within the Nüreen lineage.

concepts.name: Medonites
concepts.canon_definition: A formidable species possessing hyperdense crystalline-biological physiology, capable of withstanding extreme metaphysical pressure and dimensional torsion.
concepts.clarification: Renowned for tectonic endurance, spatial anchors, and resistance to direct conceptual erasure.

concepts.name: Archmedonites
concepts.canon_definition: The apex ontostate of the Medonites, possessing self-reinforcing crystal-lattice souls that can anchor entire realities against causal distortion.
concepts.clarification: Functions as living reality anchors in major cosmic confrontations.

concepts.name: Technogenesis
concepts.canon_definition: The advanced science and art of generating metaphysical machinery, living mechanical artifacts, and synthetic soul-vessels capable of processing Metarules.
concepts.clarification: Transcends ordinary electronics; uses pure governance structures as circuitry.

concepts.name: Technokinesis
concepts.canon_definition: The active power to command, manipulate, and interface with technogenetic apparatuses and cosmic machinery through pure thought and mental lobe activation.
concepts.clarification: Operates through specialized brain-lobe crossfunctions developed by the Varvadeil Clan.

concepts.name: Arthitean (Base Ontostate)
concepts.canon_definition: The foundational royal and warrior species of the Arthratan Throne, possessing hypergenetic biology, high Degree Q bloodline purity, and one pair of black-phoenix wings.
concepts.clarification: Possesses one pair (2 individual wings) of black-phoenix wings. High positive power skewity and extreme unstressableness.
concepts.commonly_confused_with: Demonic dark angels (They are divine black-phoenix beings, holy and royal).

concepts.name: Archarthitean
concepts.canon_definition: The second Arthitean level. Inherits all base Arthitean properties and adds higher capabilities, manifesting two pairs of black-phoenix wings.
concepts.clarification: Possesses two pairs (4 individual wings) of black-phoenix wings. Capable of undergoing Pressurised-Enlightenment and activating the Archarthitean Factor in the PHK loop.
concepts.commonly_confused_with: A separate species (It is strictly an additive ontoinheritance state: Arthitean ⊂ Archarthitean).

concepts.name: Arthitean Deity (Goddess/God of Arthiteans)
concepts.canon_definition: The third and highest Arthitean level. Inherits both prior states (Arthitean and Archarthitean) and adds supreme deity ontology, manifesting three pairs of black-phoenix wings. Rhayhara is currently the only character who fits Arthitean Deity.
concepts.clarification: Possesses three pairs (6 individual wings) of black-phoenix wings. Rhayhara's unique status: she simultaneously retains Archarthitean and Arthitean properties while commanding Arthitean Deity Factors One and Two.
concepts.formal_logic: Arthitean_Deity = Archarthitean + Arthitean + Deity_State; Wings = 3_Pairs; Rhayhara = Unique
concepts.commonly_confused_with: External gods (Arthitean Deity is the pinnacle of the Arthitean bloodline inheritance hierarchy).

concepts.name: Orotus (Holy Black Phoenix Divine Beast)
concepts.canon_definition: The Holy Black Phoenix Divine Beast of the Arthratan Mythology. The governing canonical model is Orotus_Divine_Beast_Holy_Black_Phoenix_CANON_MODEL.png. Embodying primordial black flame, sacred majesty, and sovereign aerial dominion.
concepts.clarification: CRITICAL CANON INVARIANT: The Orotus shown on Asmouth_Kartus_..._MODELS__OROTUS_ON_SHEET_INVALID.png is strictly INVALID and must never be used as a reference. Orotus is a holy divine beast, not an ordinary bird or corrupted monster.
concepts.commonly_confused_with: The invalid sheet model (The user strictly mandated that the sheet version is invalid).

concepts.name: Kafai Ranks
concepts.canon_definition: The ancient Arthitean martial, spiritual, and combat standing hierarchy, reversed and expanded to measure metaphysical prowess, unstressableness, and factor progression.
concepts.clarification: Structure is reversed and expanded: the lowest traditional rank becomes the highest meta-rank, reflecting mastery over recursive difficulty.

concepts.name: Black-Phoenix Wing Progression
concepts.canon_definition: The anatomical and spiritual black-phoenix wing system marking an Arthitean's ontoinheritance level: 1 pair for Arthiteans, 2 pairs for Archarthiteans, and 3 pairs for Arthitean Deities.
concepts.clarification: Feathers are composed of metaphysical dark flame and compressed unstressable force. Directly linked to flight, dimensional phasing, and power emission.
concepts.commonly_confused_with: Decorative wings (They are functional metaphysical organs).

concepts.name: Law of Additive Ontoinheritance
concepts.canon_definition: The structural law stating that state advancement in Arthitean ontology is additive inheritance, not type replacement: A → (A+B) → (A+B+C).
concepts.clarification: A Deity of Arthiteans does not lose Archarthitean or Arthitean status; they irreducibly possess all three property-sets simultaneously.
concepts.commonly_confused_with: State transformation or shedding of prior humanity/biology.

distinction_matrix.canonical_resolution: A higher Arthitean state does not overwrite the lower state. An Arthitean Deity remains 100% Arthitean and 100% Archarthitean by inherited possession: A → (A+B) → (A+B+C).

distinction_matrix.distinction: Orotus Canonical Model vs Sheet Invalid Model
distinction_matrix.canonical_resolution: Orotus_Divine_Beast_Holy_Black_Phoenix_CANON_MODEL.png is the SOLE canonical model. The depiction on Asmouth_Kartus_..._MODELS__OROTUS_ON_SHEET_INVALID.png is formally declared INVALID and excluded from canon.

distinction_matrix.distinction: Black-Phoenix Wings vs Ordinary Avian Wings
distinction_matrix.canonical_resolution: Black-phoenix wings are metaphysical organs of dark flame and unstressable power that scale strictly by pair count: 1 pair (Arthitean), 2 pairs (Archarthitean), 3 pairs (Arthitean Deity).
Living Concepts possess autonomous agency, self-maintenance, and consciousness. They are entities, not passive intellectual constructs.
